notes.title: Game Fixes of mechanics and achievements Update
Bug Fixing Update
notes.content:
Hello, friends! We are happy to say we've fixed the following issues on the game:

Unable to click on remaining people - https://steamcommunity.com/app/2099080/discussions/0/6741411926483306212/

Game Won't complete - https://steamcommunity.com/app/2099080/discussions/0/7119694909421824841/

Game crashing after showing the Nukearts Logo

We are aware there are some other bugs present, we still have a few more fixes planned, we shall have them uploaded soon so you may enjoy the experience as it was intended, stay tunned!!

notes.title: Recent Updates
Polishing and Fixes
notes.content:
Meow my friends! We updated the game with some adjustments.

[list]
[*] UI polishing
[*] Aditional SFX
[*] SFX and BGM volume level balancing
[*] Independent sound level option for the end game music
[*] Zoom In: you can zoom in a bit more to see things closer
[*] Minor Bug Fixes
[/list]

We were dealing with a bug where achievements weren't showing up to some players. This bug is challenging to reproduce, so we decided to change our Steamworks communication system to a custom one. We hope that this won't happen anymore, but please let us know of any issues if it happens to you.

PS: keep in mind that if Steam or your connection is down, similar problems may always occur.

notes.title: Hidden Cats in New York + Paris Update
notes.content:
Our release of Hidden Cats in London was awesome. Thanks to you all, we had a lot of feedback that allowed us to polish the game and get new ideas for new Hidden Objects projects.

[h1]Hidden Cats in London[/h1]
Small updates are on the way to polish a few things.

[h1]Hidden Cats in New York[/h1]
Our next Hidden Cats game is under production with even more contents. Expect it this Q1 of 2023. Add it to your wishlist and follow us to be aware of news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2260530/Hidden_Cats_in_New_York/

[h1]Hidden Cats in Paris[/h1]
Many people asked for more, and we are working to put Paris on the same level as London in terms of content and price. More information we'll be given on the game page as soon as we have more to share. You can expect the update release on this Q1 of 2023.

Those are just the first news that we can share with you, but more Hidden Cats games will come this year! We wish you all an amazing 2023!

notes.title: Last minor updates
notes.content:
Hi friends,
Babi worked to fix some issues that were still affecting some players.

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed: [/b]Hidden people in the advanced mode not "being selected". If you click on the wizard student before she appears in the list of 4, she'll be selected and after that, you can't pick any more.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b]: Hint on Christmas Bonus leads to a cat I already found.
[*] [b]Improved[/b]: the cats' randomness to avoid cats that look almost "invisible".
[*] [b]Improved[/b]: other little things that don't affect gameplay.
[*] [b]Achievements Bugs[/b]:
-- New players should expect no issues;
-- Players who completed the levels or are in the middle of gameplay should re-enter the level. It's expected to receive the proper achievement, if don't, try restarting the level and replaying it. If you still got an issue, please talk to us.

Other small updates might occur over the next week to polish a few things.

Special thanks to all players that discussed those topics and pointed out the bugs and proposed solutions. You are awesome!

Now Babi demands more sleep!

[/list]
